process.heading: Our UI/UX Design Process
process.subtitle: A structured, human-centered approach that turns business goals into delightful digital experiences.

steps.title: Discovery & Research
steps.description: We start with deep-dive sessions to understand your business goals, target users, and market landscape. Our designers conduct stakeholder workshops, user interviews, and competitive benchmarking to build a solid foundation.

steps.title: Define & Information Architecture
steps.description: We synthesize research findings into user journeys, site maps, and a clear content strategy. Our team plans intuitive navigation and logical layout ensuring every user finds exactly what they need.

steps.title: Wireframing & Prototyping
steps.description: Low and mid-fidelity wireframes establish layout, hierarchy, and interaction flow. Clickable prototypes let you test and validate the experience before any visual design or development begins.

steps.title: UI Design & Visual Language
steps.description: We craft pixel-perfect, responsive UI designs grounded in your brand identity. Every color, typeface, spacing, and component is chosen intentionally — balancing aesthetics with usability.

steps.title: Usability Testing & Iteration
steps.description: Every design goes through moderated usability testing with real users. We gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, then rapidly iterate to eliminate all friction before development starts.

steps.title: Developer Handoff & Support
steps.description: We deliver meticulously organized Figma files, design tokens, component docs, and Zeplin specs. Our team stays available during development to ensure pixel-perfect, flawless implementation.

faqs.question: How long does a UI/UX design project take?
faqs.answer: Typically 4–12 weeks depending on scope. A landing page redesign takes around 2 weeks, while a full product design system may take 3 months. We provide a precise timeline after our initial discovery call.

faqs.question: Do you provide Figma design files after project delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. All deliverables include fully organized Figma files with components, auto-layout, design tokens, and developer handoff specs via Zeplin or Figma Dev Mode — completely yours to keep.

faqs.question: Can you redesign our existing product?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We start with a comprehensive UX audit to identify pain points, then redesign strategically — preserving what works, fixing what doesn't, all backed by real user data.

faqs.question: What design tools does Divrit Technologies use?
faqs.answer: We use Figma for UI/UX design, FigJam for collaborative workshops, Maze for usability testing, Lottie for micro-animations, and Zeplin or Figma Dev Mode for developer handoff.

faqs.question: Do you offer post-launch design support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer flexible monthly retainer packages for ongoing design support, new feature design, A/B testing, and continuous UX optimization after your initial project is delivered.

faqs.question: Is Divrit Technologies a registered company?
faqs.answer: Yes. Divrit Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a registered IT company and sister concern of Katyayni Technologies Pvt. Ltd., founded in 2017 with 500+ successfully delivered projects across global markets.
